sentence_stem: Not only did the manager apologise,
correct_completion: but she also offered a full refund to every customer.
full_sentence: Not only did the manager apologise, but she also offered a full refund to every customer.
acceptable_variants: but she also called each affected customer personally.
but she also promised a formal investigation.

options.text: she also refused to meet the complainants.
options.why_wrong: The structure 'not only ... but also' requires a parallel positive addition. A refusal contradicts the pattern the sentence sets up.

options.text: but she also offered a full refund to every customer.

options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not an additional item in a 'not only ... but also' pair.
'Though' introduces contrast, which does not complete the additive correlative pair 'not only ... but also'.

grammar_focus: Correlative conjunction 'not only ... but also' with subject-auxiliary inversion
explanation: When a sentence begins with 'not only', the auxiliary verb comes before the subject in the first clause. The second clause must add a parallel positive action introduced by 'but also'. Learners whose first language does not invert the auxiliary here often place the subject first in the initial clause.
translation: No solo se disculpó la directora, sino que también ofreció un reembolso completo a cada cliente.
